title: The Widow's Lantern
text: A woman stands by a roadside post with a lantern, thin as a rake, wrapped in black. She has been waiting a long time for someone who went into the Gate. She asks if you have seen him, and describes him exactly.

options.label: Tell her he is coming home.

outcomes.text: She smiles and puts out the lantern and goes home.

options.label: Tell her the truth: you do not know.

outcomes.text: She nods, and keeps the lantern lit, and gives you bread.

options.label: The sharpest eye promises to look for him.

outcomes.text: You find his pack a mile on, and a ring for her.
